copyChanges: None to the brief's words on image or in Meta. Primary text 158 characters, the offer ('BUY2: 10% off 2 pieces.') ends at character 124; Meta headline 36 (40 max) with the product type, price and offer; description 27.

Lint against RULINGS: no diamond, real or solid gold, freshwater, bare 'gold' or 'silver' as the metal (only '18k gold tone PVD'), emerald or ruby, compare-at price or free shipping. No waterproof, tarnish-free or hypoallergenic claim and no water: the Toggle's tags carry the claims but its live care text says 'Keep it dry' (brief pre-flight). 'PVD', 'paperclip links', 'toggle' and 'about 22 mm' are listing words (products.md). BUY2 10% on 2+ and BUY3 20% on 3+ match RULINGS §2; two codes, so 'Codes'. Stock 77 (20+). The UTM landing URL is the only URL; it carries no signature.

Layout departures from the brief, all logged above: P 68 not 66 (skeptic); H1 76 and beat 49 instead of 68 and 44 (beat ratio kept at 0.645); card top 944 instead of 940; offer fill instead of a plum-silk foot scrim; Story H1 76 instead of 64 with the stack re-spaced; flat plum top band on the Story (the lead's call; one div).

truthNotes: Clasp matches the clasp ref (verifier and skeptic): thick round spring-gate sailor ring with gate wire, collar seam, push-pin nub and bail; one straight bar with one row of 8 tiny clear cubic zirconia, bar / ring 0.64-0.67; open paperclip links, about 13 a side.

Scale: ring / neck 0.215-0.216 (band 0.17-0.22), about 1.07-1.08x on a plausible 102-110 mm neck; 6.4 Feed px per listed mm, so no size tag. Ring width share 13.0% of the Feed width (at the floor; the frame is wider than planned).

Face: no eye, nose, lips or mouth anywhere in the native frame. The chin's underside and a hair bun sit in Story -7.5 to 185 and 0-254, under the platform header; the flat plum band covers them. RULINGS §3 allows a lips-to-chest crop, so the house rule holds either way; the brief's stricter 'no chin' gate is what the band answers.
No other jewellery, no water, no text in the picture.
